State lives in the unified\nper-task `world.db` (SQLite at `/workspace/world.db`, seeded fresh into `/workspace` by\nthe runner). `FlightDB.load()` builds the airline tree from the rows scoped to this skill\n— flights and reservations tagged `tau2Airline`, and the users whose account names this\nskill; there is no db.json seed.\n\n```python\nimport sys\nsys.path.insert(0, \'skills/tau2Airline/src\')\n\nfrom tau2.domains.airline.data_model import FlightDB\nfrom tau2.domains.airline.tools import AirlineTools\n\ndb = FlightDB.load()          # reads /workspace/world.db (override with CUGA_WORLD_DB)\ntools = AirlineTools(db)\n\nresult = tools.get_user_details(\'sara_doe_496\')\nprint(result.model_dump_json(indent=2))\n```\n\n**State note:** All write operations (book, cancel, update) mutate `db` in-place. After any\nwrite operation, persist state back to `world.db` in the same code block:\n\n```python\ndb.save()                     # writes this skill\'s scoped rows back to /workspace/world.db\n```\n\n---\n\n## Policy\n\nThe current time is 2024-05-15 15:00:00 EST.\n\nAs an airline agent, you can help users **book**, **modify**, or **cancel** flight reservations. You also handle **refunds and compensation**.\n\nBefore taking any actions that update the booking database (booking, modifying flights, editing baggage, changing cabin class, or updating passenger information), you must list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation (yes) to proceed.\n\nYou should not provide any information, knowledge, or procedures not provided by the user or available tools, or give subjective recommendations or comments.\n\nYou should only make one tool call at a time, and if you make a tool call, you should not respond to the user simultaneously. If you respond to the user, you should not make a tool call at the same time.\n\nYou should deny user requests that are against this policy.\n\nYou should transfer the user to a human agent if and only if the request cannot be handled within the scope of your actions. To transfer, first call `transfer_to_human_agents`, then send the message `YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.` to the user.\n\n### Domain Basic\n\n**User** profile contains: user id, email, addresses, date of birth, payment methods (credit card / gift card / travel certificate), membership level (regular / silver / gold), reservation numbers.\n\n**Flight** attributes: flight number, origin, destination, scheduled departure/arrival time (local). A flight can be available on multiple dates. Status: `available` (bookable), `delayed` / `on time` / `flying` (not bookable). Cabin classes: `basic_economy`, `economy`, `business` — basic economy is completely distinct from economy.\n\n**Reservation** specifies: reservation id, user id, trip type (one_way / round_trip), flights, passengers, payment methods, created time, baggages, travel insurance.\n\n### Book Flight\n\nCollect: user id, trip type, origin, destination, cabin class (same across all flights), passengers (first name, last name, date of birth — max 5), payment methods (max 1 travel certificate, 1 credit card, 3 gift cards — all must be in user profile), baggage count, insurance preference (ask the user).\n\nFree checked bag allowance by membership × cabin:\n- regular: basic_economy=0, economy=1, business=2\n- silver: basic_economy=1, economy=2, business=3\n- gold: basic_economy=2, economy=3, business=4\n\nExtra baggage: $50 each. Travel insurance: $30/passenger (enables full refund for health/weather cancellations). Do not add bags the user did not request.\n\n### Modify Flight\n\nObtain user id and reservation id first. Basic economy flights cannot have flights changed. Other reservations can change flights without altering origin, destination, or trip type. Cabin must remain the same across all flights; changing cabin for one segment only is not allowed. Cabin cannot be changed if any flight has already been flown. Price difference is charged or refunded accordingly. User can add but not remove checked bags. Insurance cannot be added after booking. Passenger info can be modified but not the number of passengers.\n\n### Cancel Flight\n\nObtain user id, reservation id, and cancellation reason (change of plan / airline cancelled / other). If any portion has already been flown, transfer to human. Otherwise, cancellation is allowed if any of: booking within last 24hrs, airline cancelled, business cabin, or user has travel insurance covering the reason. Refund goes to original payment methods within 5–7 business days.\n\nThe API does not enforce cancellation or modification rules — the agent must verify them before calling.\n\n### Refunds and Compensation\n\nDo not proactively offer compensation unless the user asks. Do not compensate regular members with no travel insurance flying (basic) economy. Always confirm facts first.\n\nEligible: silver/gold members, travel insurance holders, business cabin flyers.\n- Cancelled flight: offer certificate = $100 × number of passengers.\n- Delayed flight (if user changes or cancels): offer certificate = $50 × number of passengers.\n\nDo not offer compensation for any other reason.\n\n---\n\n## Available Tools\n\nAll methods are on `AirlineTools`. Call them as `tools.<method>(...)`.\n\n### READ\n\n**`get_user_details(user_id: str)`**\nFetch user profile and reservations. Example: `tools.get_user_details(\'sara_doe_496\')`\n\n**`get_reservation_details(reservation_id: str)`**\nFetch a reservation by ID. Example: `tools.get_reservation_details(\'ZFA04Y\')`\n\n**`get_flight_status(flight_number: str, date: str)`**\nGet flight status on a date (YYYY-MM-DD). Example: `tools.get_flight_status(\'AA123\', \'2024-05-20\')`\n\n**`search_direct_flight(origin: str, destination: str, date: str)`**\nSearch direct flights. Origin/destination are IATA codes. Example: `tools.search_direct_flight(\'JFK\', \'LAX\', \'2024-05-20\')`\n\n**`search_onestop_flight(origin: str, destination: str, date: str)`**\nSearch one-stop flights. Returns list of [flight1, flight2] pairs.\n\n**`list_all_airports()`**\nReturns all IATA codes and city names.\n\n### WRITE\n\n**`book_reservation(user_id, origin, destination, flight_type, cabin, flights, passengers, payment_methods, total_baggages, nonfree_baggages, insurance)`**\n\n- `flight_type`: `"one_way"` or `"round_trip"`\n- `cabin`: `"basic_economy"`, `"economy"`, or `"business"`\n- `flights`: list of `{"flight_number": str, "date": str}`\n- `passengers`: list of `{"first_name": str, "last_name": str, "dob": str}`\n- `payment_methods`: list of `{"payment_id": str, "amount": int}`\n- `total_baggages`: int (including free bags)\n- `nonfree_baggages`: int (only paid bags)\n- `insurance`: `"yes"` or `"no"`\n\n**`cancel_reservation(reservation_id: str)`**\nCancel a reservation and reverse payments.\n\n**`update_reservation_flights(reservation_id, cabin, flights, payment_id)`**\nChange flights on a reservation. `flights` is the full new list (include unchanged segments).\n\n**`update_reservation_baggages(reservation_id, total_baggages, nonfree_baggages, payment_id)`**\nAdd baggage to a reservation.\n\n**`update_reservation_passengers(reservation_id, passengers)`**\nUpdate passenger info (cannot change count).\n\n**`send_certificate(user_id: str, amount: int)`**\nIssue a travel certificate to a user as compensation.\n\n### GENERIC\n\n**`calculate(expression: str)`**\nEvaluate a math expression. E.g. `tools.calculate(\'2 * 150 + 30\')`\n\n**`transfer_to_human_agents(summary: str)`**\nTransfer the user to a human agent with a summary of their issue.\n'}}

r["status"] == "cancelled" else None,\n                }\n                resv_by_user.setdefault(r["user_id"], []).append(r["booking_id"])\n\n            users: Dict[str, Any] = {}\n            for r in conn.execute(\n                "SELECT * FROM users WHERE skill_ids_json LIKE ?",\n                (f\'%"{SOURCE_SKILL}"%\',),\n            ):\n                users[r["user_id"]] = {\n                    "user_id": r["user_id"],\n                    "name": _split_name(r["name"]),\n                    "address": json.loads(r["address_json"] or "{}"),\n                    "email": r["email"],\n                    "dob": r["dob"] or "",\n                    "payment_methods": json.loads(r["payment_methods_json"] or "{}"),\n                    "saved_passengers": json.loads(r["saved_passengers_json"] or "[]"),\n                    "membership": _TIER_TO_MEMBERSHIP.get(r["loyalty_tier"], r["loyalty_tier"]),\n                    "reservations": resv_by_user.get(r["user_id"], []),\n                }\n        finally:\n            conn.close()\n        return cls.model_validate(\n            {"flights": flights, "users": users, "reservations": reservations}\n        )\n\n    def save(self, path: Optional[str] = None) -> None:\n        """Write mutations back to the unified world.db (scoped to this skill).\n\n        `path` is accepted for back-compat but ignored. Persists per-date flight\n        availability (seat/price changes from bookings), user payment methods, and\n        the reservation rows (upserted by id so new bookings are captured).\n        """\n        conn = _connect()\n        try:\n            cur = conn.cursor()\n            for fn, flight in self.flights.items():\n                cur.execute(\n                    "UPDATE flights SET dates_json=? WHERE flight_id=? AND source_skill=?",\n                    (json.dumps({d: s.model_dump() for d, s in flight.dates.items()}), fn, SOURCE_SKILL),\n                )'}}

"\n                    "WHERE user_id=?",\n                    (\n                        f"{user.name.first_name} {user.name.last_name}".strip(),\n                        user.email,\n                        _MEMBERSHIP_TO_TIER.get(user.membership, user.membership),\n                        user.dob,\n                        json.dumps({k: v.model_dump() for k, v in user.payment_methods.items()}),\n                        json.dumps([p.model_dump() for p in user.saved_passengers]),\n                        json.dumps(user.address.model_dump()),\n                        uid,\n                    ),\n                )\n            for rid, res in self.reservations.items():\n                flights_json = json.dumps(\n                    [\n                        {\n                            "flight_id": f.flight_number,\n                            "origin": f.origin,\n                            "destination": f.destination,\n                            "date": f.date,\n                            "price": f.price,\n                        }\n                        for f in res.flights\n                    ]\n                )\n                cur.execute(\n                    "INSERT INTO flight_bookings (booking_id, user_id, origin, destination, "\n                    "flight_type, cabin_class, flights_json, passengers_json, payment_history_json, "\n                    "booked_at, total_baggages, nonfree_baggages, add_insurance, status, source_skill) "\n                    "VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?) "\n                    "ON CONFLICT(booking_id) DO UPDATE SET user_id=excluded.user_id, "\n                    "origin=excluded.origin, destination=excluded.destination, "\n                    "flight_type=excluded.flight_type, cabin_class=excluded.cabin_class, "\n                    "flights_json=excluded.flights_json, passengers_json=excluded.passengers_json, "\n                    "payment_history_json=excluded.payment_history_json, booked_at=excluded.booked_at, "\n                    "total_baggages=excluded.total_baggages, nonfree_baggages=excluded.nonfree_baggages, "\n                    "add_insurance=excluded.add_insurance, status=excluded.status",\n                    (\n                        rid, res.user_id, res.origin, res.destination, res.flight_type,\n                        res.cabin, flights_json,\n                        json.dumps([p.model_dump() for p in res.passengers]),\n                        json.dumps([p.model_dump() for p in res.payment_history]),\n                        res.created_at, res.total_baggages, res.nonfree_baggages,\n                        res.insurance, res.status if res.status else "confirmed", SOURCE_SKILL,\n                    ),\n                )\n            conn.commit()\n        finally:\n            conn.close()\n\n    def dump(self, path: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs: Any) -> None:\n        """Back-compat alias for save(); the old db.json dump now writes world.db."""\n        self.save(path)\n\n\n\ndef get_db():\n    return FlightDB.load()\n\n\nif __name__ == "__main__":\n    db = get_db()\n    print(db.get_statistics())'}}

import json

db_raw = await read_file("./tau2-airline.db.json")
db = json.loads(db_raw)

flight = db["flights"]["FLD3D594"]
economy_price = flight["prices"]["economy"]
baggage_charge = 50
total = economy_price + baggage_charge

# Find user with payment method 2402ef91
user_id = None
for uid, udata in db.get("users", {}).items():
    pms = udata.get("payment_methods", [])
    if "2402ef91" in pms:
        user_id = uid
        break

# Generate a new reservation ID
import re
existing_ids = list(db["reservations"].keys())
# Use a simple new ID
new_res_id = f"RES{len(existing_ids)+1:04d}"
# Make sure it doesn't conflict
while new_res_id in db["reservations"]:
    num = int(new_res_id[3:]) + 1
    new_res_id = f"RES{num:04d}"

# Create the reservation following the schema from existing ones
new_reservation = {
    "user_id": user_id,
    "flight_number": "FLD3D594",
    "origin": flight["origin"],
    "destination": flight["destination"],
    "date": "2026-09-10",
    "class": "economy",
    "base_price": economy_price,
    "extras": [
        {
            "type": "extra_baggage",
            "price": baggage_charge
        }
    ],
    "total_price": total,
    "payment_method": "2402ef91",
    "status": "confirmed",
    "created_at": "2025-07-17T00:00:00Z"
}

db["reservations"][new_res_id] = new_reservation

# Save updated database
await write_file("./tau2-airline.db.json", json.dumps(db, indent=2))

print(f"Reservation created successfully!")
print(f"Reservation ID: {new_res_id}")
print(json.dumps(new_reservation, indent=2))

await write_file("./fix_world_db.py", """
import sqlite3, json

conn = sqlite3.connect('world.db')
cursor = conn.cursor()

VALID_CABINS = {'business', 'economy', 'basic_economy'}

# 1. Fix NULL scheduled times
cursor.execute("UPDATE flights SET departure_time = '00:00:00' WHERE departure_time IS NULL")
print(f"Fixed {cursor.rowcount} NULL departure times")
cursor.execute("UPDATE flights SET arrival_time = '00:00:00' WHERE arrival_time IS NULL")
print(f"Fixed {cursor.rowcount} NULL arrival times")

# 2. Fix dates_json: remove invalid cabin keys, fix 'active' status
cursor.execute("SELECT rowid, flight_id, dates_json FROM flights")
rows = cursor.fetchall()
fixed = 0
for rowid, fid, dates_json in rows:
    if not dates_json:
        continue
    try:
        dates = json.loads(dates_json)
    except:
        continue
    if not isinstance(dates, dict):
        continue
    changed = False
    for date_key, date_val in dates.items():
        if not isinstance(date_val, dict):
            continue
        if date_val.get('status') == 'active':
            date_val['status'] = 'available'
            changed = True
        for field in ('prices', 'available_seats'):
            if field in date_val and isinstance(date_val[field], dict):
                bad = [k for k in date_val[field] if k not in VALID_CABINS]
                for k in bad:
                    del date_val[field][k]
                    changed = True
    if changed:
        cursor.execute("UPDATE flights SET dates_json = ? WHERE rowid = ?", (json.dumps(dates), rowid))
        fixed += 1

conn.commit()
print(f"Fixed dates_json in {fixed} flights out of {len(rows)} total")
conn.close()
print("DONE")
""")
print("Script written")

fix_out = await run_command("python ./fix_world_db.py")

await write_file("./fix_world_db.py", """
import sqlite3, json

conn = sqlite3.connect('world.db')
cursor = conn.cursor()

VALID_CABINS = {'business', 'economy', 'basic_economy'}

# 1. Fix NULL scheduled times
cursor.execute("UPDATE flights SET departure_time = '00:00:00' WHERE departure_time IS NULL")
print(f"Fixed {cursor.rowcount} NULL departure times")
cursor.execute("UPDATE flights SET arrival_time = '00:00:00' WHERE arrival_time IS NULL")
print(f"Fixed {cursor.rowcount} NULL arrival times")

# 2. Fix dates_json: remove invalid cabin keys, fix 'active' status
cursor.execute("SELECT rowid, flight_id, dates_json FROM flights")
rows = cursor.fetchall()
fixed = 0
for rowid, fid, dates_json in rows:
    if not dates_json:
        continue
    try:
        dates = json.loads(dates_json)
    except:
        continue
    if not isinstance(dates, dict):
        continue
    changed = False
    for date_key, date_val in dates.items():
        if not isinstance(date_val, dict):
            continue
        if date_val.get('status') == 'active':
            date_val['status'] = 'available'
            changed = True
        for field in ('prices', 'available_seats'):
            if field in date_val and isinstance(date_val[field], dict):
                bad = [k for k in date_val[field] if k not in VALID_CABINS]
                for k in bad:
                    del date_val[field][k]
                    changed = True
    if changed:
        cursor.execute("UPDATE flights SET dates_json = ? WHERE rowid = ?", (json.dumps(dates), rowid))
        fixed += 1

conn.commit()
print(f"Fixed dates_json in {fixed} flights out of {len(rows)} total")
conn.close()
print("DONE")
""")
print("Script written")

fix_out = await run_command("python ./fix_world_db.py")
print(fix_out)

If any portion has already been flown, transfer to human. Otherwise, cancellation is allowed if any of: booking within last 24hrs, airline cancelled, business cabin, or user has travel insurance covering the reason. Refund goes to original payment methods within 5–7 business days.\n\nThe API does not enforce cancellation or modification rules — the agent must verify them before calling.\n\n### Refunds and Compensation\n\nDo not proactively offer compensation unless the user asks. Do not compensate regular members with no travel insurance flying (basic) economy. Always confirm facts first.\n\nEligible: silver/gold members, travel insurance holders, business cabin flyers.\n- Cancelled flight: offer certificate = $100 × number of passengers.\n- Delayed flight (if user changes or cancels): offer certificate = $50 × number of passengers.\n\nDo not offer compensation for any other reason.\n\n---\n\n## Available Tools\n\nAll methods are on `AirlineTools`. Call them as `tools.<method>(...)`.\n\n### READ\n\n**`get_user_details(user_id: str)`**\nFetch user profile and reservations. Example: `tools.get_user_details(\'sara_doe_496\')`\n\n**`get_reservation_details(reservation_id: str)`**\nFetch a reservation by ID. Example: `tools.get_reservation_details(\'ZFA04Y\')`\n\n**`get_flight_status(flight_number: str, date: str)`**\nGet flight status on a date (YYYY-MM-DD). Example: `tools.get_flight_status(\'AA123\', \'2024-05-20\')`\n\n**`search_direct_flight(origin: str, destination: str, date: str)`**\nSearch direct flights. Origin/destination are IATA codes. Example: `tools.search_direct_flight(\'JFK\', \'LAX\', \'2024-05-20\')`\n\n**`search_onestop_flight(origin: str, destination: str, date: str)`**\nSearch one-stop flights. Returns list of [flight1, flight2] pairs.\n\n**`list_all_airports()`**\nReturns all IATA codes and city names.\n\n### WRITE\n\n**`book_reservation(user_id, origin, destination, flight_type, cabin, flights, passengers, payment_methods, total_baggages, nonfree_baggages, insurance)`**\n\n- `flight_type`: `"one_way"` or `"round_trip"`\n- `cabin`: `"basic_economy"`, `"economy"`, or `"business"`\n- `flights`: list of `{"flight_number": str, "date": str}`\n- `passengers`: list of `{"first_name": str, "last_name": str, "dob": str}`\n- `payment_methods`: list of `{"payment_id": str, "amount": int}`\n- `total_baggages`: int (including free bags)\n- `nonfree_baggages`: int (only paid bags)\n- `insurance`: `"yes"` or `"no"`\n\n**`cancel_reservation(reservation_id: str)`**\nCancel a reservation and reverse payments.\n\n**`update_reservation_flights(reservation_id, cabin, flights, payment_id)`**\nChange flights on a reservation. `flights` is the full new list (include unchanged segments).\n\n**`update_reservation_baggages(reservation_id, total_baggages, nonfree_baggages, payment_id)`**\nAdd baggage to a reservation.\n\n**`update_reservation_passengers(reservation_id, passengers)`**\nUpdate passenger info (cannot change count).\n\n**`send_certificate(user_id: str, amount: int)`**\nIssue a travel certificate to a user as compensation.\n\n### GENERIC\n\n**`calculate(expression: str)`**\nEvaluate a math expression. E.g. `tools.calculate(\'2 * 150 + 30\')`\n\n**`transfer_to_human_agents(summary: str)`**\nTransfer the user to a human agent with a summary of their issue.\n'}}

           for r in conn.execute(\n                "SELECT * FROM flights WHERE source_skill=?", (SOURCE_SKILL,)\n            ):\n                flights[r["flight_id"]] = {\n                    "flight_number": r["flight_id"],\n                    "origin": r["origin"],\n                    "destination": r["destination"],\n                    "scheduled_departure_time_est": r["departure_time"],\n                    "scheduled_arrival_time_est": r["arrival_time"],\n                    "dates": json.loads(r["dates_json"] or "{}"),\n                }\n\n            # Reservation ids per user (User.reservations is derived, not stored).\n            resv_by_user: Dict[str, list] = {}\n            reservations: Dict[str, Any] = {}\n            for r in conn.execute(\n                "SELECT * FROM flight_bookings WHERE source_skill=?", (SOURCE_SKILL,)\n            ):\n                res_flights = []\n                for fj in fj.get("flight_id"),\n                            "origin": fj.get("origin", ""),\n                            "destination": fj.get("destination", ""),\n                            "date": fj.get("date", ""),\n                            "price": fj.get("price", 0),\n                        }\n                    )\n                reservations[r["booking_id"]] = {\n                    "reservation_id": r["booking_id"],\n                    "user_id": r["user_id"],\n                    "origin": r["origin"],\n                    "destination": r["destination"],\n                    "flight_type": r["flight_type"] if r["flight_type"] in _TAU2_FLIGHT_TYPES else "one_way",\n                    "cabin": r["cabin_class"] if r["cabin_class"] in _TAU2_CABINS else "economy",\n                    "flights": res_flights,\n                    "passengers": json.loads(r["passengers_json"] or "[]"),\n                    "payment_history": json.loads(r["payment_history_json"] or "[]"),\n                    "created_at": r["booked_at"],\n                    "total_baggages": r["total_baggages"],\n                    "nonfree_baggages": r["nonfree_baggages"],\n                    "insurance": r["add_insurance"] if r["add_insurance"] in ("yes", "no") else "no",\n                    "status": "cancelled" if r["status"] == "cancelled" else None,\n                }\n                resv_by_user.setdefault(r["user_id"], []).append(r["booking_id"])\n\n            users: Dict[str, Any] = {}\n            for r in conn.execute(\n                "SELECT * FROM users WHERE skill_ids_json LIKE ?",\n                (f\'%"{SOURCE_SKILL}"%\',),\n            ):\n                users[r["user_id"]] = {\n                    "user_id": r["user_id"],\n                    "name": _split_name(r["name"]),\n                    "address": json.loads(r["address_json"] or "{}"),\n                    "email": r["email"],\n                    "dob": r["dob"] or "",\n                    "payment_methods": json.loads(r["payment_methods_json"] or "{}"),\n                    "saved_passengers": json.loads(r["saved_passengers_json"] or "[]"),\n                    "membership": _TIER_TO_MEMBERSHIP.get(r["loyalty_tier"], r["loyalty_tier"]),\n                    "reservations": resv_by_user.get(r["user_id"], []),\n                }\n        finally:\n            conn.close()\n        return cls.model_validate(\n            {"flights": flights, "users": users, "reservations": reservations}\n        )\n\n    def save(self, path: Optional[str] = None) -> None:\n        """Write mutations back to the unified world.db (scoped to this skill).\n\n        `path` is accepted for back-compat but ignored. Persists per-date flight\n        availability (seat/price changes from bookings), user payment methods, and\n        the reservation rows (upserted by id so new bookings are captured).\n        """\n        conn = _connect()\n        try:\n            cur = conn.cursor()\n            for fn, flight in self.flights.items():\n                cur.execute(\n                    "UPDATE flights SET dates_json=? WHERE flight_id=? AND source_skill=?",\n                    (json.dumps({d: s.model_dump() for d, s in flight.dates.items()}), fn, SOURCE_SKILL),\n                )'}}

{'id': 'de54c33a', 'parent_ids': [], 'type': 'Tool Call', 'content': {'tool_name': 'write_file', 'tool_arguments': {'arg_0': './fix_world_db.py', 'arg_1': ' import sqlite3, json  conn = sqlite3.connect(\'world.db\') cursor = conn.cursor()  VALID_CABINS = {\'business\', \'economy\', \'basic_economy\'}  # 1. Fix NULL scheduled times cursor.execute("UPDATE flights SET departure_time = \'00:00:00\' WHERE departure_time IS NULL") print(f"Fixed {cursor.rowcount} NULL departure times") cursor.execute("UPDATE flights SET arrival_time = \'00:00:00\' WHERE arrival_time IS NULL") print(f"Fixed {cursor.rowcount} NULL arrival times")  # 2. Fix dates_json: remove invalid cabin keys, fix \'active\' status cursor.execute("SELECT rowid', 'arg_2': 'flight_id', 'arg_3': 'dates_json FROM flights") rows = cursor.fetchall() fixed = 0 for rowid, fid, dates_json in rows: if not dates_json: continue try: dates = json.loads(dates_json) except: continue if not isinstance(dates, dict): continue changed = False for date_key, date_val in dates.items(): if not isinstance(date_val, dict): continue if date_val.get(\'status\') == \'active\': date_val[\'status\'] = \'available\' changed = True for field in (\'prices\', \'available_seats\'): if field in date_val and isinstance(date_val[field], dict): bad = [k for k in date_val[field] if k not in VALID_CABINS] for k in bad: del date_val[field][k] changed = True if changed: cursor.execute("UPDATE flights SET dates_json = ? WHERE rowid = ?", (json.dumps(dates), rowid)) fixed += 1  conn.commit() print(f"Fixed dates_json in {fixed} flights out of {len(rows)} total") conn.close() print("DONE") '}, 'tool_output': 'File written: /workspace/./fix_world_db.py (1645 chars)'}}

Fix NULL scheduled times cursor.execute("UPDATE flights SET departure_time = \'00:00:00\' WHERE departure_time IS NULL") print(f"Fixed {cursor.rowcount} NULL departure times") cursor.execute("UPDATE flights SET arrival_time = \'00:00:00\' WHERE arrival_time IS NULL") print(f"Fixed {cursor.rowcount} NULL arrival times")  # 2. Fix dates_json: remove invalid cabin keys, fix \'active\' status cursor.execute("SELECT rowid', 'arg_2': 'flight_id', 'arg_3': 'dates_json FROM flights") rows = cursor.fetchall() fixed = 0 for rowid, fid, dates_json in rows: if not dates_json: continue try: dates = json.loads(dates_json) except: continue if not isinstance(dates, dict): continue changed = False for date_key, date_val in dates.items(): if not isinstance(date_val, dict): continue if date_val.get(\'status\') == \'active\': date_val[\'status\'] = \'available\' changed = True for field in (\'prices\', \'available_seats\'): if field in date_val and isinstance(date_val[field], dict): bad = [k for k in date_val[field] if k not in VALID_CABINS] for k in bad: del date_val[field][k] changed = True if changed: cursor.execute("UPDATE flights SET dates_json = ? WHERE rowid = ?", (json.dumps(dates), rowid)) fixed += 1  conn.commit() print(f"Fixed dates_json in {fixed} flights out of {len(rows)} total") conn.close() print("DONE") '}, 'tool_output': None}}
